reasoning.text:
[p0 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Fresh level1: symmetric pinwheel maze, two cyan 5x5 blocks at (21,51)/(41,51) are the only distinct interactive markers. Diverse probe to learn action semantics: click left cyan, then a vertical move, a horizontal move, and interact.

[p1 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Mirror-control mechanic: two cyan blocks, vertical synced, horizontal mirrored. Maze is asymmetric so I must learn the blocked-block rule. action3(left) keeps both open reaching L(44,19)/R(44,39); then action1(up) is asymmetric (left can ascend, right is wall-blocked) -- observe whether right stays while left moves (decouple) or both freeze.

[p2 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Decoupling rule verified (blocked block stays, other moves). Joint BFS path to merge both blocks at center-top (9,29) is [3,1,3,1,1,1,1,1,4,4,4,1,4]. Sending first 10 to validate the transition model across several decoupling steps; final merge moves (4,1,4) follow next. Goal hypothesis: full overlap = win.

[p3 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Blocks at L(14,24)/R(14,39) as predicted (model 16/16). Final merge: a4 (right block slides left to 34, left block wall-blocked stays), a1 (both up to row9 top corridor), a4 (both converge to (9,29) fully overlapping). Tests merge=win hypothesis.

[s0 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=1 engine=0 accuracy=100.0

[p4 | acting_agent | action_plan]
New Level 2: 4x4 mirror blocks (vs L1 5x5), new checkerboard hazard (palette 8), halves meet at bottom corridor rows46-53. Probe [3,2] (left, down) in the open top area to measure the new step size and confirm mirror/vertical-sync before routing toward the merge; avoids all hazards.

[s1 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=2 engine=1 accuracy=100.0

[p5 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L2 model = 4x4 blocks/4-step, mirror+decoupling (same family as L1). Joint-BFS merge target (50,30) bottom corridor. First 9 moves are robust regardless of hazard(8) nature; the 10th (down) tests whether 8 blocks movement (right block should STAY at row34 if 8 is wall-like). Avoids ever landing on 8.

[p6 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Hazard 8 confirmed LETHAL (step30 reset blocks to start). Recomputed merge route avoiding any move that targets an 8 cell: 23-move path to merge at (46,26) bottom corridor. Sending first 10 (hazard-free by construction); blocks predicted to track model (verified 1.0).

[s2 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=3 engine=2 accuracy=100.0

[p7 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Positions verified exactly on model (L22,18 / R26,42). Continuing hazard-free 23-move merge route; sending next 10 to reach L(46,26)/R(50,26), holding final 3 merge moves [4,1,3] to observe reward at merge.

[p8 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Blocks at L(46,26)/R(50,26) in bottom corridor as predicted. Final merge: a4 separates, a1 aligns rows via decoupling (L wall-blocked, R rises to row46), a3 converges both to (46,26) full overlap. Tests merge=win for L2; reward expected.

[p9 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L3 new: 8 is now a SOLID wall-region (not hazard), 3 new 2x2 markers(9). Probe drives right block to cover the right marker at step7 (hazard-free, no 8-target) to confirm the 4x4/mirror model carries, test whether markers are passable, and observe marker semantics (light/consume/reward). Steps 0-6 are robust regardless of marker nature.

[s3 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=4 engine=3 accuracy=100.0

[p10 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Marker(9) confirmed wall-like (blocks entry, not consumed); center marker blocks the only bridge so merge needs markers removed. ACTION5/6 still no-op and must be functional -> test if clicking a marker (right marker at 39,31 with right block nearby; left marker at 11,19 with no block) or ACTION5 removes/toggles it or opens the bridge.

[p11 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Markers are click-toggles that arm both players (10->1) and keep exactly one marker active. Left marker now active. Test whether ARMED (color1) players still respond to movement (a3 then a2) and observe any interaction; predict if mobile L->(46,18),R->(34,46).

[s4 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=5 engine=4 accuracy=100.0

[p12 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Armed-state confirmed: movement moves the active marker(color11), players(color1) frozen, and the marker leaves path behind (so relocating center marker opens the blocked bridge). Pivotal test: click the active marker again to see if it toggles off / un-arms players back to cyan(10); then ACTION1 to reveal whether players (un-armed) or the marker now moves.

[p13 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L3 win is marker-based (players freeze permanently once armed; merge impossible). CENTER marker is the unique bridge key. Activate it (click 31,15), slide it off the bridge (a4: opens crossing cols30-33), then probe ACTION5 (commit?) and another a4 (target-tile), watching for reward at each step.

[s5 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=6 engine=5 accuracy=100.0

[p14 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Bridge-open gave no reward and marker cannot reach players, so the win likely still needs the two players to merge -> the armed freeze must be reversible. Test whether clicking on a player(color1) cell un-arms it (reverts to cyan 10). Click both players and watch their palette.

[p15 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L3 fully understood: merge=win but requires relocating all 3 markers off the merge route (arm via marker click, move active marker, un-arm via player click). Current player positions are messy from probing; RESET to the clean symmetric design-start for a regular, verifiable full solve next.

[p16 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L3 full solve (verified by simulation): relocate all 3 markers off the merge route, disarm, then 31-move mirror merge. Chunk 1 parks the CENTER marker: click it (31,15) to arm+activate, then cursor-move it to (11,15) off the merge corridor. Validates marker-move model over 11 moves before continuing.

[s6 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=7 engine=6 accuracy=100.0

[p17 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L3 chunk2 (model matched chunk1 exactly): park LEFT marker (click 11,19 then 2,2,2,2,3 -> (35,7)), park RIGHT marker (click 39,31 then 4,4,4 -> (31,51)), then DISARM by clicking left player (22,46) -> players become mobile cyan. Then chunk3 is the 31-move merge.

[p18 | acting_agent | action_plan]
All 3 markers parked off-route; players disarmed cyan at (46,22)/(46,38). Final mirror merge route recomputed on current maze reaches ((26, 22), (26, 22)) in 31 moves. Sending first 10.

[p19 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L3 merge final stretch: markers parked, players cyan merging. Remaining route to full-overlap merge at (26, 22) is 21 moves; sending next chunk. Reward expected at the overlap.

[p20 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L3 final merge: identity verified positional (no crossing; env tracked route exactly). From (14,10)/(10,50) the 11-move route [4,4,4,4,2,4,4,2,2,2,4] converges both cyan players to full overlap at (26,22) -> merge reward expected.

[s7 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=8 engine=7 accuracy=99.2

[p21 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L4 decisive probe of two load-bearing unknowns: a1 tests up/down mirror (right block row 19=same-dir vs 29=mirror); ACTION6(30,30) arms+activates the 3x3 center marker; a4 tests whether the 3x3 marker actually moves (engine doubts it for >4 cells). Solution (marker relocation to enable merge) hinges on marker being movable.

[s8 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=9 engine=8 accuracy=98.5

[p22 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L4 confirmed: standard up/down model + 3x3 marker movable (5-step, leaves path). RESET to clean start, then begin verified relocation: click(30,30) arms+activates marker, [4,4,1,1] parks it at (20,40) (the decoupling-wall position that makes merge reachable). Then disarm+merge next.

[p23 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L4 final: marker parked at (20,40) (verified) provides the decoupling wall enabling merge. Disarm by clicking armed player cell (14,34) -> players become mobile cyan; then verified 6-move merge [4,1,1,2,4,4] converges both to (29,29) for the win.

[s9 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=10 engine=9 accuracy=98.6

[p24 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L5 entry probe. Two sealed mirror halves, players L(50,6) R(50,54), N=4, no palette-8 hazard. Confirm: ACTION1=up moves both up to r46; ACTION4 mirror horizontal dirs; 2nd ACTION4 should make L hit val6 4x4 block @ c14-17 (wall) and STAY while R keeps sliding (decouple). Learns mirror sign + decouple + whether coloured/val6 blocks are walls. Stop to observe.

[s10 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=11 engine=9 accuracy=98.6

[p25 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L5 probe: click center of the right-half free-standing green block (val14 @ col34-37,row26-29). Tests whether the new coloured blocks are ACTION6-clickable/interactive (marker-like, as in L3/L4) -- the prime suspect mechanic for clearing the divider bars that trap each player in its band. Single click, observe.

[p26 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L5 push test. From L(46,2): ACTION2 down->(50,2); ACTION3 inward x3 slides L to (50,10) then targets the isolated P-block(15) @ r50-53 c14-17. Observe whether the P-block gets pushed to c18-21 (push mechanic), L stays (solid wall), or L overlaps (passable/goal pad). Right player just slides inward through its empty Band C (no confound).

[p27 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L5 merge solve, verified prefix. Halves connect at Band A (rows6-21, central cols30-33 are path) so the franchise merge is reachable. Drive RIGHT player up col46 (5 ups) then to green KEY (26,34); predict it consumes the key and CLEARS the LEFT div1 gate (val14 @ r22-25 c14-25). LEFT player decouples/stays low. Stop to verify the cross-half key->gate clearing before executing the remaining 19 moves of the 28-move merge.

[s11 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=12 engine=10 accuracy=98.7

[p28 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L5 pressure-plate solve, verification chunk. Reposition L to (42,10) and R onto orange plate (26,58) [opens LEFT div2], then 2x ACTION1 to carry L up through div2 into Band B while R stays pinned on the plate (R is wall-blocked from moving up). Predict end: L(34,10) in Band B, R(26,58). Confirms the cross-half pinned-plate gate-crossing before executing the rest of the 39-move merge to (6,30).

[s12 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=13 engine=11 accuracy=98.8

[p29 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L5 completion: pressure-plate model verified in env (L crossed div2 while R pinned orange plate). Execute remaining 30-move safety-constrained merge from L(34,10),R(26,58): position+cross div1 (L into Band A, moves13-14 while R pinned green plate), bring R up to val15 plate region, cross right-div1 (R into Band A, moves22-23 while L pinned val15 plate (6,14)), then converge both 4x4 blocks to anchor (6,30) in the shared Band A hall = full overlap merge -> reward.

[s13 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=14 engine=12 accuracy=100.0

[p30 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L6 probe. Safe under either vertical sign (if up: both land on top plates (14,18) val12 & (14,42) val14; if down: harmlessly blocked at row26 by closed gates, no hazard). Observe: vertical direction, whether both gates (val14 cols14-25 left, val12 cols38-49 right) open when plates pressed, and (next call) whether they LATCH open or are pressure-hold. This decides the L6 gate mechanic vs L5.

[s14 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=15 engine=13 accuracy=100.0

[p31 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L6 latch-vs-hold test. Both players currently on top plates with BOTH gates open. ACTION2 x4 descends both. If gates LATCH open: both pass to row30 inside the open gates (30,18)/(30,42) en route to bottom band. If PRESSURE-HOLD: leaving plates recloses gates, both block at row26 (closed gate=wall, NOT hazard, safe). Observe gate state + player rows to decide L6 gate mechanic, then route to merge at (42,30) over the val9.

[p32 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L6 ACTION5-latch test. Climb both players up onto their plates (14,18) val12 & (14,42) val14 via 3x up (both gates open while pressed), press ACTION5 (hypothesis: latches the pressed gate(s) open permanently), then ACTION2 to step OFF the plates. Observe: do the gates STAY open (left gate rows30-33 c14-25, right gate c38-49)? Latch=>solvable (walk both to bottom band, merge at (42,30) over val9). If they reclose, ACTION5-latch is wrong; revisit val9/asymmetric bottom plate.

[s15 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=16 engine=14 accuracy=100.0

[p33 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L6 symmetry-break probe. Movement is locked in perfect mirror lockstep (cannot decouple) and ACTION5/ pressure-hold gates leave the level unsolvable as modeled, so the missing mechanic must be ACTION6 click. val9 (rows43-44 cols31-32) is the franchise MARKER colour (L3/L4 markers were exactly the ACTION6 click-targets). Click its cell (x=31,y=43) and observe any change: players arming (10->1), a movable cursor, a gate/path opening, or recolor -- whatever breaks the mirror deadlock.

[p34 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L6 marker-move probe. val9 click armed players (val1) and made val9 the active marker (val11) -- the L3/L4 cursor mechanic. ACTION1 should now move the 2x2 active marker (currently (43,31)) as a cursor (not the frozen players). Observe its new position, the lattice step size, and whether it leaves path(5) behind. This marker is the symmetry-breaking movable wall; next I will route it into one player path to force decoupling, then disarm.

[p35 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L6 marker-movement probe. Players armed; val11 marker active at (43,31), blocked upward by the center hazard fence. Move the marker LEFT twice to read: step size (2x2 marker may step by 2 or 4), travel direction, and whether vacated cells become path(5). This calibrates the marker model so I can route it to a pin-below-plate position (to force player decoupling) and off the merge target.

[p36 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L6 solution chunk 1/N (verify marker routing). Marker is active at (43,23); ACTION1 up x2 then ACTION3 left should move it to (35,19) per the subagent simulator (marker on 4-lattice, leaves path, blocked by hazard/wall/gate). Confirm it reaches (35,19) before continuing the 36-action merge plan (saved /tmp/l6plan.json).

[p37 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L6 solution chunk 2 (open-gate marker delivery). From: marker(35,19), players armed(18,18)/(18,42). Disarm (click armed L player 18,18) -> players mobile; ACTION1 climbs both onto plates (14,18)val12 & (14,42)val14 -> BOTH gates open; re-arm (click marker @35,19) -> players freeze on plates keeping gates open; ACTION1 x4 walks the marker UP through the now-open LEFT gate (rows30-33 cols14-25) to (19,19); disarm (click L player @14,18). Verify marker reaches (19,19) and players rest on plates -- confirms armed-on-plate keeps gate open (assumption 3) and sets up the pin.

[p38 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L6 CRITICAL pin test. Marker is a wall at (19,19), players mobile on plates (14,18)L/(14,42)R, both gates open. ACTION2 down x3: the marker overlaps L's down-target footprint (rows18-21 cols18-21) so L should be PINNED on the val12 plate (stays at (14,18), holding the RIGHT gate open); R is free and descends to (26,42). Verify DECOUPLE: L stays (14,18), R reaches (26,42). This confirms the partial-footprint pin (assumption 2) -- the crux of the whole solution.

[s16 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=17 engine=15 accuracy=100.0

[p39 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L6 chunk idx14-22 (un-pin L, first descent of R through gate, verify gate-rest + a3 sign). Arm marker@(19,19); marker down x2 to (27,19) (un-pins L); disarm; then ply: ACTION2 L(14,18)->(18,18) & R(26,42)->(30,42) [R enters open right gate, L was on val12 plate pre-move]; ACTION4(outward) L->(18,14), R stays (30,42); ACTION2 x3 -> R exits gate downward to (42,42), L descends to (26,14). Predicted end: L(26,14), R(42,42), marker(27,19). Verifies rest-on-closing-gate is non-lethal+exitable (risk1) and ACTION4=outward sign. Per simulator this is on the verified path to merge at (34,14).

[p40 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L6 CORRECTED plan (sign fix: L6 ACTION4=INWARD/ACTION3=OUTWARD, per synth env-confirmed step236). From actual state L(26,22),R(42,42),marker wall(27,19). This chunk: L up+outward to (26,14); R inward/down to the val14 BOTTOM plate (42,18) which OPENS the left gate (g14). Predict end L(26,14),R(42,18),g14 open. Marker stays a wall at (27,19). Then final chunk descends L through the open left gate and converges to merge at (34,14). Risk1 (gate-rest) already confirmed by R's earlier successful right-gate descent.

[s17 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=18 engine=16 accuracy=100.0

[p41 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L6 FINAL chunk -> MERGE. State: L(26,14),R(42,18 on val14 plate, left gate OPEN),marker wall(27,19). ACTION2: L enters open left gate ->(30,14), R->(46,18) (leaves plate, gate closes, L rests on closed gate). ACTION4(inward): L blocked stays (30,14), R->(46,14). ACTION2: L exits gate down ->(34,14), R->(50,14). ACTION1 x4: R climbs (50,14)->(34,14) to OVERLAP L = MERGE at (34,14). Hazard-free (verified sim); gate-rest already env-confirmed. Expect reward -> L6 solved, score->6.
